case_number: Civil Appeal No. 13407 of 2024; Civil Appeal No. 13408 of 2024

parties.petitioner: Om Prakash Gupta Alias Lalloowa (Now Deceased) & Ors.
parties.respondent: Satish Chandra (Now Deceased); Smt. Rooprani (Now Deceased)

summary: Two civil appeals concerning delays in substitution of legal representatives in long-pending second appeals arising from suits for specific performance. In CA 13407, the second appeal abated due to failure to substitute deceased respondent Satish Chandra's heirs; later restoration was recalled. In CA 13408, the second appeal was dismissed for non-prosecution after Rooprani's death; recall and substitution were sought after delay. The High Court dismissed condonation applications due to inordinate delay. Issue: whether High Court erred in refusing to condone delay and allow substitution. Supreme Court examines balance between procedural compliance and substantive justice, considering neglect and laches.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 136 of the Constitution of India
Order XXII Rule 4 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of; no specific order on merit but proceedings allowed subject to exceptions, with observation on need to balance procedural rigour with justice.
